reviews.title: True Type fonts probably won’t work
reviews.text: AnyFont support will tell you that your font is installed according to their app. And from there they punt on support. If you can’t actually access your font or use it they will just tell you they have done their job getting it onto the device, not being able to USE the font is a system limitation beyond their control.

reviews.title: Reclamo
reviews.text: Compré esta aplicación porque tiene para muchos Idiomas; la descargué la abrí y no me apareció nada. Pedí mi reembolso por internet y no me han respondido; espero que lean este mensaje y lo entiendan.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: After following the guidance posted by the help page, I was still unable to install a single font. I followed all of the directions, including going through the sketchy VPN process. No font was ever added to IOS. Most of the positive reviews were from 10 years ago. I was fooled by the high rating and thought that the $2 would be worth it. It wasn’t because the app does not do what is promised. It is outdated.

reviews.title: Unintuitive user interface
reviews.text:
This app has one of the most bizarrely unintuitive non-Apple compliant user interfaces I’ve come across.  Sorry, but I should not have to read instructions to figure out how this app works.  It should be obvious by design. Look at “Simple Font Manager” to see how it’s done correctly, and that utility is free.

Follow-up:  rather than reach out and assist me, or offer a refund, you can see how this developer responded.  I have no connection to creation or marketing of the other app I mentioned… clearly there’s no profit motive in it either, because it is offered free of charge.  I’m just a satisfied user of it.

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: This is supposed to be able to select an entire folder of fonts and install them, instead you have to pick each font individually.  Nobody has time for that.  Lies! It was also advertised as not needing to create profiles to be installed. More lies.  This is just supposed to install fonts into the system fonts.  That’s not how this works! And the UI for the app indicates an entire folder can be selected. If the developer doesn’t like the feedback then fix the UI and stop advertising outside the App Store that the app works in a manner it does not.  INCLUDING ON YOUTUBE, which should not be a substitute for in-app documentation! This app absolutely does not perform according to the methods described on YouTube or blog ads, nor does it behave as described in the UI.

reviews.title: A complete waste of money and time
reviews.text:
False advertising. They tell you that you can download all these fonts but when you go to do so, it only upsells you on crating your own font and wants you to pay for another app. This app is a scam. DO NOT BUY. 

***update***

I have received a response from the company in the most unprofessional manor, degrading me multiple times and asking me to change my review. If the had simply helped me in understanding their app that I still claim is not user friendly and horrible described in their description then I would charge my review but since they acted like high school children with their demeaning rebuttals clearly showing that they don’t care for customer service, then I will leave my bad review up and stand by it. DO NOT BUY!
